description: This file defines the 'Order' aggregate root entity within the domain model of an e-commerce application. It includes properties and methods related to customer orders, including encapsulation of order items and calculation of total order cost.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order aggregate, encapsulating order details, items, and total calculation.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Order instance, initializing buyer ID, shipping address, and order items.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total price of all items in the order.
